Diatribæ. De animâ humanâ, ejusque potentiâ intellectivâ

book: Academic disputation (diatriba) in Latin, Basel 1640, on the human soul and its intellective power: front dedications, then the diatriba divided into numbered theses, then a closing verse dedication to the respondent.
